items.claim: Seed value at a schema start-auto path stays unpinned
`MissingTrial` Close live but dead on the last trial
Trial story builds a fresh, empty store every render
items.note: The story is not published, so it has no changeset and no test.

items.claim: Layer toggle/reorder undo steps restore nothing
items.note: A history the instrument mounts itself now records the step too.

items.claim: `dragDrop` without `canvas` shows a palette but nothing drops
items.note: This was a behavior call, so I made the strict one: `cameraOf` throws, as it already does for `orbit` beside `canvas`. There is no opt-in override, because a palette that cannot drop has no use. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round fifty-one (2026-11-20): labkit's trials". Question: should `stage` and `orbit` cameras get a drop target instead?
The docked and undocked sections now read their props through one `sectionProps` mapping.

items.claim: `trialHistoryOf` drops save/restore and stamps by whole ms
items.note: This needed new API in `@weasel-js/history`, fixed 8fd43adb72: `History.restore` now takes a `rebuildOp`, asked before the history's own. Its changeset is `minor`, with the `api` tag. The stamp code that `sceneTrialHistory` and `trialHistoryOf` shared moved into `undo/historyStamps.ts`.
